references.provenance: Actual selected individual portrait restored byte-identically from local Git LFS object; no replacement bitmap.

silhouette: Human xenolinguist with source-height slim/average proportions, long split teal coat and dark trousers/tall lace-up boots.
anatomy: Two human arms and legs; five fingers on each hand when individually readable; preserve apparent age from the reference, no numerical age invented.
face: Warm medium-brown skin, black brows and eyes behind small round cyan-blue luminous spectacles; dark almost-black hair in a high messy bun with front loose strands.
costume: Long weathered deep teal coat with dark turned-up scarf/collar and grey-olive lapel/inner vest panels; dark underlayer and trousers; brown crossing leather straps, broad belt, rectangular pouches and bracers/fingerless gloves; dark high lace boots.
palette: Deep teal, charcoal/navy, muted grey-olive, warm worn brown leather, cyan spectacles and signal lamp, small violet backpack crystal.
distinguishingMarks: Round cyan-blue spectacles, high black bun, backpack frame behind shoulders with upright violet crystal at her anatomical left.
equipment: A SINGLE long handled signal-lamp carried in her anatomical LEFT hand: dark metal/wood shaft, stepped collars, caged bell/lantern head containing cyan-blue glowing glass. Right hand is free unless scene explicitly uses it to support the same object.
forbiddenMixes: Do not substitute the old atlas identity: it has an ivory open shirt/white cuffs and no blue spectacles, lamp or crystal backpack.
Mara Ell is a xenolinguist of Greywake in The Drowned Testament, not Mara Veylan, Celeste Ray or a scientist from another universe.

scopeLimitations: Selected HEROES_DB portrait and production.audiovisual.portrait agree on this exact individual V2 bitmap; it is an internal original-project authority, not an external official franchise source.
A single pixel-art source does not resolve exact iris detail, hidden back/backpack geometry, tiny labels, or a chronological age; no perfect1:1 approval is claimed.
World architecture and new locations are original scenes consistent with Greywake, the Pelagic Institute, abyssal harbor investigation and dream geometry, not official source screenshots.
Gameplay attacks do not establish canonical physical equipment beyond the visible single signal lamp.
The divergent old atlas remains unchanged as a historical variant, not current identity evidence.
CG05 is Nexus gameplay; CG09-11 are Fan Art; CG12-15 are What If. CG15 depicts a first assignment at the same apparent age, never an invented child incarnation.
